blocks.title: Private sailing in the Sea of Cortez
blocks.text: Your own group, your own boat. The crew runs the sea, the day is yours: diving in, learning the wind, a kite session, scubadiving, enjoying a good wine with delicious food by our chefs, or nothing at all.

lines: Meet our founder and hear the story behind Eagle Ray.
blocks.note: And a surprise for everyone who joins us at NIV.

blocks.title: Ocean adventures led by passionate sea people
blocks.text: We don’t hire crews. We choose people: passionate sea people who can’t stay away from the water, who notice before you ask, and who know when a group needs a dive or a nap. Everything Eagle Ray is, starts with them.
